verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents public Cloud APIs that can be called over REST or through client libraries in popular languages to automate workflows. Per-service REST references exist, such as the Cloud Billing REST API and the Budget API, and the gcloud CLI wraps these same APIs. Programmatic access is governed by IAM and Workload Identity Federation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end through the API.
